These are so delicious and how nourishing to have the fiber and nutrients from the sweet potatoes! 

Full recipe below.. always in captjion! 

Sweet Potato Brown Sugar and Cinnamon Graham Crackers ✨❤️😋   200 g all-purpose flour (about 1⅔ cups) + 2 tablespoons  •  170 g whole wheat flour (about 1½ cups) •  1 tsp baking soda •  1½ tsp cinnamon •  ¼ tsp nutmeg (optional) •  ½ tsp kosher salt •  8 oz (226 g / 2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened •  5 oz (142 g) dark brown sugar, packed •  2 Tbsp maple syrup  •  150 g cooked, mashed sweet potato (about ⅔ cup), cooled and fairly dry(roast or steam, then mash; blot with paper towel if watery) •  Optional topping: 2 Tbsp butter + dark brown sugar + 1½ tsp cinnamon  1.  Heat oven to 350°F. 2.  Whisk both flours, baking soda, cinnamon,, and salt. 3.  Cream butter, brown sugar, and syrup until smooth (not fluffy). 4.  Mix in the mashed sweet potato until even. 5.  Add dry ingredients on low speed. The dough will look crumbly at first, then darken. Squeeze a handful: it should hold like pie dough.  •  Too dry / won’t clump: add 1 Tbsp very soft butter.  •  Too sticky: add 1–2 Tbsp AP flour.Don’t add water or milk. 6.  Divide onto 2 sheets of parchment. Shape each into a compact rectangle. If sticky, chill 30–60 minutes. 7.  Cover with more parchment and roll to about ⅛ inch (3 mm). Peel and smooth the top paper as it wrinkles.  Bake 15-20 minutes -
